title: METAL SLUG / ONLINE REFERENCE PILOT
variant: Neo Geo MVS four-slot big-red shell, with Metal Slug in the first mini-marquee bay
preview_note: 40 x 56 px | MVS big red / original-art scan / two players / four-button panel / other bays blank

cabinet.author: Beeblebrox (Wikipedia)
cabinet.rights: Photo CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/; printed SNK artwork and trademarks retain their underlying rights. Derived logo extractions and renders acknowledge this photo license.
cabinet.purpose: Red MVS shell, black molding, Neo Geo/MVS/SNK side logos and four-slot marquee geometry. The photographed custom deck is not reused.

marquee.rights: Printed artwork credits copyright 1996 NAZCA CORPORATION and SNK trademarks. Scan hosted by a third-party archive, not publisher permission or a verified redistribution license.
marquee.purpose: Original Metal Slug mini-marquee, title, tank, Marco and A/B/C/D action labels. Originality supported by printed credits and the photographed conversion cabinet, not independently authenticated by the publisher.

controls.rights: Archive photo of an SNK-branded panel; photographer and redistribution license unknown. Original panel/reproduction status not independently authenticated.
controls.purpose: Red diagonal-striped MVS panel, black sticks and red/yellow/green/blue four-button layout.

conversion.rights: Archive cabinet photograph; author/license unknown, underlying artwork NAZCA/SNK.
conversion.purpose: Corroborates original mini-marquee appearance and four-button layout. Black single-slot conversion is a different variant and is not used as the red shell texture.

screen.rights: Captured from the user's existing local ROM; game imagery copyright NAZCA/SNK. No ROM downloaded or committed.
screen.purpose: Real Metal Slug display from the pinned Neo Geo core, mslug.state, port 0 Start for 15 frames, then 600 neutral frames. Native core output 304x224.

uncertainties: This is a supported MVS big-red interpretation, not a unique factory-dedicated Metal Slug cabinet; the game was a cartridge/kit.
The photographed red cabinet has custom deck artwork. The pilot deliberately uses a separate SNK-striped panel reference instead.
Metal Slug occupies one mini-marquee bay; other bays are blank rather than misrepresenting other games. The game remains mslug only, not a selectable multi-game machine.
Only one red cabinet side is documented. The generic Neo Geo/MVS/SNK print is reused on the opposite side with readable orientation; no game-specific character side art is invented.
Publisher-hosted digital master art was not found. Third-party scans/photos and their underlying artwork rights need review before redistribution/deployment.
